description: Notification policy of the synthetic Harborline Construction pack. Events come from the platform's closed list; this pack uses none of the formal review or extension events. Content levels are stated explicitly for the pack's four-level scale (Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted, with no privileged level). Data, not code. Synthetic.
